items.text: Important decisions should be made by:

options.A: Those with the most expertise and experience (hierarchy)
options.B: Experts with meaningful input from those affected
options.C: Depends entirely on the type of decision
options.D: Consensus with guidance from experienced members

items.text: A company can have a strong CEO who makes final calls OR a flat structure where all voices are equal. Which produces better outcomes?

options.B: Leadership usually better, with employee input
options.C: Depends entirely on context and organization
options.D: Flat usually better, with some coordination role
options.E: Flat structure—collective wisdom exceeds individual judgment

options.A: Held by those with expertise, experience, or proper appointment
options.B: Based on competence and accepted by those affected
options.C: It serves the common good, however determined
options.D: Derived from consent of those governed
